chunks: He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi reported to me, he said: Muhammad ibn Idris reported to us, he said: al-Hasan ibn Atiyyah narrated to us, he said: A man called Israil narrated to us, from Maysarah ibn Habib, from al-Minhal, from Zirr ibn Hubaysh, from Hudhayfah who said:

The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said to me: "Did you see the person who presented himself to me?" I said: "Yes, O Messenger of God." He said: "That was an angel who had never descended to the earth before this moment. He sought permission from God, Mighty and Majestic, to greet Ali, and He granted him permission, so he greeted him. And he gave me the glad tidings that al-Hasan and al-Husayn are the two masters of the youths of Paradise, and that Fatimah is the leading lady of the women of Paradise."

key_terms.سَيِّدَا شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: The two masters of the youths of Paradise
key_terms.سَيِّدَةُ نِسَاءِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: The leading lady of the women of Paradise
key_terms.مَلَكٌ: Angel (malak) - a heavenly being that had never before descended to earth

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about an angel greeting Imam Ali and the status of Hasan, Husayn, and Fatimah?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) informed his companion Hudhayfah about an angel who descended to earth for the first time specifically to greet Imam Ali (AS). This hadith establishes three key virtues: the exalted status of Imam Ali as one whom even angels seek permission to greet, the rank of al-Hasan and al-Husayn as masters of the youths of Paradise, and the distinction of Fatimah al-Zahra as the leading lady of the women of Paradise.
word_analysis: and he gave me glad tidings

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi reported to me from Muhammad ibn ldress who reported from al-Hasan ibn Atiyyah who reported from a man called Israeel, from Maysarah ibn Habib, from al-Minhal , from Dharr ibn Jaysh, from Huzaifah who said:

The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, (once) said to me: "Did you see the person who presented himself to me?" I said: "Yes, O messenger of Allah." He said: "He was an angel who had never descended before this. He sought permission from Allah, Most High, to greet ‘Ali; he was granted permission and then greeted him. And he gave me glad news that al-Hasan and al-Husayn are the masters of the youths of Paradise, and Fatimah is the leading lady of all the women in Paradise."
